title: Verb to be
summary: Use be to talk about identity, age, descriptions, location and states.

explanation.en: We use the verb be to say who or what someone is, describe people and things, and talk about where they are.
explanation.ru: Глагол to be нужен, чтобы сказать, кто или что это, описать человека или предмет и сказать, где кто-то находится.

forms.label: Present
forms.pattern: I am · he/she/it is · you/we/they are

forms.label: Questions
forms.pattern: Am I ...? · Is he/she/it ...? · Are you/we/they ...?

commonMistakes.note: With be, do not use do/does for negatives.
